facts.en: Completed a social research bachelor degree at Fictional Otter College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构水獭学院取得社会研究学士学位。

facts.en: Research administration assistant at Fictional Willow Study Centre, 2022-10 to 2024-06.
facts.zh: 2022-10 至 2024-06 在虚构柳树研究中心任研究行政助理。

facts.en: Editorial support assistant at the same centre, 2024-07 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2026-08 在同一中心任编辑支持助理。

facts.en: Checked references, figure labels and document versions for researcher review.
facts.zh: 检查参考文献、图表标签及文档版本，供研究人员审核。

facts.en: Supported a 2025 manuscript draft on fictional library services with 3 researchers.
facts.zh: 2025 年与 3 名研究人员合作支持一篇关于虚构图书馆服务的论文草稿。

facts.en: Personally formatted 46 references and maintained the author-query list; researchers wrote the analysis and conclusions.
facts.zh: 个人负责排版 46 条参考文献并维护作者询问清单；分析及结论由研究人员撰写。

facts.en: As of 2026-08, the manuscript had not been submitted, accepted or published.
facts.zh: 截至 2026-08，该稿件尚未提交、录用或发表。

facts.en: Authorship order and inclusion were not finalized; no published authorship is claimed.
facts.zh: 作者排序及名单尚未确定；不声称具有已发表论文署名。

facts.en: Before an internal review in 2025-11, corrected 12 citation-format issues among 46 references; this was an editorial result, not research validation.
facts.zh: 2025-11 内部审核前，在 46 条参考文献中修正 12 项引文格式问题；这是编辑成果，不是研究验证。

facts.en: Uses Word tracked changes, reference-manager exports and version logs.
facts.zh: 使用 Word 修订、文献管理器导出及版本日志。

facts.en: Drafted a journal submission checklist in 2026-02; no journal submission was performed using it.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草期刊投稿核对表；未使用它执行期刊投稿。

facts.en: Attended a 2024 seminar on publication ethics without receiving a professional accreditation.
facts.zh: 2024 年参加出版伦理研讨会，未获得专业认证。

facts.en: Scheduled researcher review meetings and recorded action owners.
facts.zh: 安排研究人员审核会议并记录行动负责人。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Story Lantern from 2023-01 to 2023-05 on evenings during paid employment.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2023-05 有薪工作期间晚间在虚构故事灯笼做志愿者。

facts.en: Proofread a volunteer newsletter; this was not a peer-reviewed research publication.
facts.zh: 校对志愿者通讯；它不是同行评审研究出版物。

facts.en: A 2022 coursework poster summarized public-domain fictional survey data and was presented only in class.
facts.zh: 2022 年课程海报总结公开可用的虚构调查数据，仅在课堂展示。

facts.en: An old CV draft labels the manuscript a published paper; that label conflicts with the current status record.
facts.zh: 旧简历草稿将该稿件列为已发表论文；该标签与当前状态记录冲突。
